chart_title: Intelligence Index vs. Cost to Run Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
x_axis: Cost to Run Intelligence Index (USD, Log Scale)
cost_unit: USD to run all Intelligence Index evaluations

universe.selection_evidence: The public chart model selector displayed 694 of 694 models after Select all. The total-cost chart SVG contained 189 circles and a Pareto path with 18 M/L coordinate pairs, each matching a circle centre exactly (distance 0 px).

method: Built-in browser only. Opened the Intelligence Index evaluation page, selected Intelligence Index vs. Total Cost, then Select all. Read every circle centre and the Pareto path from the chart SVG, matched each path vertex to the circle at the same coordinates, then hovered all 189 circles through ordinary browser mouse input and recorded each public tooltip verbatim. One overlapped pair (circles 72 and 137, 0.1 px apart) was resolved by a hover 2 px to the left, confirmed by provider fill colour and log-scale x position (see duplicate_resolution). Claude Haiku 5.5 tooltips carry an asterisk footnote, recorded per point. No embedded payload, API, export or paid data was used.

precision.intelligence_index: Rounded integer displayed by public tooltip; raw precision is not recovered from SVG coordinates.
precision.total_cost_usd: Two decimal places displayed by public tooltip.

duplicate_resolution: Circle 72 (fill #1f1f1f, OpenAI colour, cx 502.07) and circle 137 (fill #1c7ff8, Zhipu colour, cx 502.16) overlap; both centre hovers returned the GLM-5.2 (max) tooltip. A hover 2 px left of the pair returned 'GPT-5.5 (medium) $2,095.12 / 34' verbatim; assigned to circle 72 because the log-scale x axis ($2k at 498.30, $3k at 531.25) places $2,095.12 at 502.08 and $2,097.29 at 502.17, and the fill colours match each provider's other points.

comparison_to_previous_capture.basis: Rendered Pareto path vertices matched to circles and read from public tooltips on both dates.

near_frontier_policy.basis: Public rounded integer Intelligence Index and two-decimal USD total cost from the chart tooltips. The frontier's intelligence at a point's cost is the highest intelligence among rendered-frontier points whose cost is at or below that cost; a point cheaper than every frontier point has no gap.

frontier.footnote: Claude Haiku 5.5 has 5x higher pricing on longer-context inputs which are not currently reflected; we are working to include this in cost figures across Artificial Analysis.
